additional_info.subject: RE: 0428275-DC/Si-D/AT-[MP/S7170003961] Charging issue CRM:02888000041
additional_info.body:
Dear Cenoiu Catalin George,
Thank you for reaching out.
After a thorough review of the session logs, we can confirm that the charging process was automatically terminated due to a standard system timeout during the stop phase. This is a built-in safety mechanism designed to ensure the charger shuts down gracefully when a final confirmation signal is not received.
We’d also like to assure you that no sessions recorded identical MeterStart and MeterStop values, which confirms that energy was successfully delivered and no free charging occurred. The system operated within expected parameters.
If you observe a similar issue again, please don’t hesitate to notify us. We will escalate the matter to our experts for a deeper investigation to ensure optimal performance of your charging experience.
Thank you for your continued trust.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
